<div class="card-body">
'''Captain Lennox''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] ([[Imperial]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊レノックス艦長</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力に２（艦が「タイラント」なら３）を加える。スター・デストロイヤー上にいるなら、自分の各支配フェイズに１回、その艦の「牽引ビーム」を使用することができる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Captain-Lennox-PSA-160326784.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">インペリアル・スター・デストロイヤー“タイラント”の艦長。有能なリーダー。帝国の将校には珍しく、艦と乗組員に愛情を注いでいる。軍に政治を持ち込むことを極端に嫌う。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Captain Lennox.

'''Card text:'''
Adds 2 to the power of a starship he pilots (3 if the ship is Tyrant). If aboard a Star Destroyer, once during each of your control phases he may use that ship's Tractor Beam.

'''Lore:'''
Captain of the Imperial Star Destroyer Tyrant. An able leader. Unlike most Imperial officers, he is devoted to his ship and crew. He strongly dislikes bringing politics into the service.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Captain Lennox]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
